story.reading: eo? ni jin-jja wan-na? o-raen-man-i-da jin-jja!
story.en: Huh? You actually came? It's really been a while!

story.text: 와... '몰라볼' 뻔했다. 어릴 땐 코흘리개였는데 이래 예뻐질 줄 몰랐네.
story.reading: wa... mol-la-bol ppeon-haet-da. eo-ril ttaen ko-heul-li-gae-yeon-neun-de i-rae ye-ppeo-jil jul mol-lan-ne.
story.en: Whoa... I almost didn't recognize you. You were a snot-nosed kid, I didn't know you'd turn out this pretty.

story.text: 와 이래 빤히 보노? 오랜만에 '놀리는' 재미가 쏠쏠하다.
story.reading: wa i-rae ppan-hi bo-no? o-raen-man-e nol-li-neun jae-mi-ga ssol-ssol-ha-da.
story.en: Why are you staring at me like that? Teasing you after so long is way too fun.

story.text: 사실... 니 온다는 소식 듣고 좀 '설레긴' 했다. 티 내진 마라이.
story.reading: sa-sil... ni on-da-neun so-sik deut-go jom seol-le-gin haet-da. ti nae-jin ma-ra-i.
story.en: Actually... when I heard you were coming, I got a little excited. Don't go around telling people though.

story.text: 와 또 딴청 피우네. 내가 이래 '능청스럽게' 넘어가는 거 알제?
story.reading: wa tto ttan-cheong pi-u-ne. nae-ga i-rae neung-cheong-seu-reop-ge neo-meo-ga-neun geo al-je?
story.en: See, dodging the subject again. You know I'm good at playing it cool, right?

story.text: 해운대 바닷바람이나 좀 쐬자. 오랜만에 옛날 얘기도 좀 하고.
story.reading: hae-un-dae ba-dat-ba-ram-i-na jom ssoe-ja. o-raen-man-e yen-nal yae-gi-do jom ha-go.
story.en: Let's go feel the sea breeze at Haeundae. We can catch up on old times too.

story.text: 단어는 다 챙겼제? 이번엔 대화 상황 문제도 있으니까, 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 한번 맞혀봐라.
story.reading: dan-eo-neun da chaeng-gyeot-je? i-beon-en dae-hwa sang-hwang mun-je-do it-eu-ni-kka, mu-seun il-i beol-eo-ji-neun-ji han-beon mach-yeo-bwa-ra.
story.en: Got all the words down? This chapter also has a conversation question — try to figure out what's going on.

words.example_en: I was so glad to meet my friend after a long time.
I almost didn't recognize my friend after not seeing them for so long.

words.example: 형이 자꾸 나를 놀려서 화가 났다.
words.example_reading: hyeong-i ja-kku na-reul nol-lyeo-seo hwa-ga nat-da
words.example_en: My older brother kept teasing me, so I got upset.

words.example: 여행 가기 전날 밤은 마음이 설렌다.
words.example_reading: yeo-haeng ga-gi jeon-nal bam-eun ma-eum-i seol-len-da
words.example_en: The night before a trip, my heart flutters with excitement.
He nonchalantly acted like he didn't know.

sentences.en: I was very glad to meet my friend after a long time.
He walked right past me without recognizing me.
Sunwoo kept teasing me and laughing.
My heart fluttered when I heard the news.
He nonchalantly acted like nothing was going on.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 야! 니 진짜 오랜만이다. 공항에서 여까지 혼자 잘 찾아왔나?
turns.reading: ya! ni jin-jja o-raen-man-i-da. gong-hang-e-seo yeo-kka-ji hon-ja jal chaj-a-wan-na?
turns.en: Hey! It's really been a while. Did you find your way here alone okay from the airport?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 어, 어렵지 않았어. 근데 너 하나도 안 변했네.
turns.reading: eo, eo-ryeop-ji an-a-sseo. geun-de neo ha-na-do an byeon-haen-ne.
turns.en: Yeah, it wasn't hard. But you haven't changed a bit.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 내는 그대로지. 근데 니는... 마 몰라볼 뻔했다. 많이 예뻐졌네.
turns.reading: nae-neun geu-dae-ro-ji. geun-de ni-neun... ma mol-la-bol ppeon-haet-da. man-i ye-ppeo-jyeon-ne.
turns.en: I'm the same as always. But you... I almost didn't recognize you. You've gotten really pretty.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 뭐라카노, 그런 말을 그렇게 갑자기 하나.
turns.reading: mwo-ra-ka-no, geu-reon mal-eul geu-reo-ke gap-ja-gi ha-na.
turns.en: What are you saying, blurting that out so suddenly.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객에게 이런 말을 한 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo say this to the passenger?
dialogues.correct_answer: 오랜만에 만난 승객이 많이 예뻐져서 놀라서
options: 오랜만에 만난 승객이 많이 예뻐져서 놀라서
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 오랜만에 본 승객이 몰라볼 정도로 예뻐진 것에 놀라 놀리듯 말하고 있습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니 옛날에 여기서 아이스크림 흘리가 울고불고 난리쳤던 거 기억나나?
turns.reading: ni yen-nal-e yeo-gi-seo a-i-seu-keu-rim heul-li-ga ul-go-bul-go nal-li-chyeot-deon geo gi-eok-na-na?
turns.en: Do you remember crying and making a huge fuss here as a kid because you dropped your ice cream?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그, 그건 언제 적 얘기를 아직도 하나!
turns.reading: geu, geu-geon eon-je jeok yae-gi-reul a-jik-do ha-na!
turns.en: Th-that's ancient history, why bring it up now!

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 하하, 니가 하도 웃겨가 아직도 생생하다. 지금도 그리 잘 흘리나?
turns.reading: ha-ha, ni-ga ha-do ut-gyeo-ga a-jik-do saeng-saeng-ha-da. ji-geum-do geu-ri jal heul-li-na?
turns.en: Haha, you were so funny that I still remember it vividly. Do you still drop things that easily?

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: I don't drop things! Stop teasing me already.

dialogues.question: 선우는 왜 옛날 이야기를 꺼냈나요?
dialogues.question_en: Why does Sunwoo bring up an old story?
dialogues.correct_answer: 승객의 어릴 적 모습을 떠올리며 놀리려고
options: 승객의 어릴 적 모습을 떠올리며 놀리려고
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 어릴 때 아이스크림을 흘리며 울었던 승객의 모습을 떠올리며 장난스럽게 놀리고 있습니다.
